  let int_fract_pair_n := (GenContFract.of v).stream n
  let (int_n, frac_n) := int_fract_pair_n
  let next_term := 1 / frac_n
  let int_next := ⌊next_term⌋
  let dens_n := (GenContFract.of v).dens n
  let dens_n_plus_1 := (GenContFract.of v).dens (n + 1)

  have h_b : (GenContFract.of v).partDens.get? n = some b := nth_partDenom_eq

  have h_int_n_eq_b : int_n = b :=
    match int_fract_pair_n with
    | ⟨b', fr⟩ => rfl

  have h_frac_n_pos : 0 < frac_n :=
    by
      rw [h_int_n_eq_b]
      exact (GenContFract.IntFractPair.stream.eq_def v n).2.2

  have h_int_next_ge_b : int_next ≥ b :=
    by
      rw [h_int_n_eq_b]
      apply Int.ceil_le_of_lt
      exact (GenContFract.IntFractPair.stream.eq_def v n).2.1
      exact h_frac_n_pos

  have h_dens_n_plus_1_ge_mul : dens_n_plus_1 ≥ int_next * dens_n :=
    by
      rw [GenContFract.dens_rec]
      exact le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_refl _) (le_refl _)

  exact mul_le_mul_left (le_refl _) (le_refl _) (le_trans h_int_next_ge_b (le_refl _))
